Q: XAMPP Apache not starting - php7ts.dll? A:

I had to download the x86 thread-safe PHP 7.3.1 version in order to get Apache start again. Although on a Windows 64-bit machine, x64 wouldn't work with my old (32-bit) Xampp installation.

You may want to take a look at VisualTorch (https://visualtorch.readthedocs.io/en/latest/). People already used it for their research publications.

Q: How to compile the source code of CrossOver on Mac? A:

I asked Google Gemini. It provided some instructions regarding Homebrew. I was able to install the required packages but I don't have "llvm" and "clang" folders in the downloaded source code tarball, only a "wine" folder and a bunch of other folders. Should I skip the llvm and clang compilation processes and jump straight to the wine compilation? Update: I tried this and it said that the llvm included doesn't support ARM64 cross-compilation. It said to install a package called "llvm-mingw", does this package exist in Homebrew in an Apple Silicon compatible version?
